from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.structure import get_structural_review, get_structural_serializer
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Structural_Review(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_structural_review"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("classifications_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("cluster_ids_json",     "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("decoration_ids_json",  "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_output("review_json",      "string")
        self.add_output("overall_score",    "float")
        self.add_output("grade",            "string")
        self.add_output("production_ready", "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        _default = {"review_json": "{}", "overall_score": 0.0, "grade": "F", "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}

        try:
            cls_json  = str(inputs.get("classifications_json") or "[]")
            clu_json  = str(inputs.get("cluster_ids_json")     or "[]")
            dec_json  = str(inputs.get("decoration_ids_json")  or "[]")
            classifications = json.loads(cls_json)  if cls_json.strip()  else []
            cluster_ids     = json.loads(clu_json)  if clu_json.strip()  else []
            decoration_ids  = json.loads(dec_json)  if dec_json.strip()  else []
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Failed to parse input JSON: {exc}")
            return _default

        if not isinstance(classifications, list):
            classifications = [classifications]
        if not isinstance(cluster_ids, list):
            cluster_ids = []
        if not isinstance(decoration_ids, list):
            decoration_ids = []

        reviewer   = get_structural_review()
        serializer = get_structural_serializer()

        result = reviewer.review(classifications, cluster_ids, decoration_ids)

        self.log_info(
            f"Structural review: grade={result.grade} score={result.overall_score:.2f} "
            f"production_ready={result.production_ready} "
            f"structural={result.structural_count}/{result.asset_count}"
        )
        if result.findings:
            for f in result.findings:
                self.log_warning(f"  Finding: {f}")

        return {
            "review_json":      serializer.serialize_review(result),
            "overall_score":    result.overall_score,
            "grade":            result.grade,
            "production_ready": result.production_ready,
            "exec_out":         True,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Structural_Review
